title: 36 Hours in Florence, Italy
abstract: Nighttime strolls, lesser-known museums and tiny trattorias reveal a more intimate side of this popular Italian destination.

title: 36 Hours in Montreal
abstract: Climb a mountain, wander the waterfront and enjoy a smoked-meat sandwich in a city with a surprise around every corner.

title: 36 Hours in Glasgow
abstract: Take in Gothic architecture, green riverside walks and a global banquet in Scotland’s largest city, which crackles with character. Just be waterproof.

title: 36 Hours on the North Fork, Long Island
abstract: By late fall on Long Island’s North Fork, the crowds have ebbed, the beaches are mostly empty and locals are enjoying the autumn harvest.
